LanguageData.TitheOverBudget: If the used tithe budget is greater than the available tithe budget, then at tax time, all selected tithe options will be pruned until the used budget meets the available budget.
LanguageData.RandomTithesDesc:
At tax time, you will receive a random selection of items, with a total value equal to or less than the Random Tithe Budget. You can add or remove items to the list to control what is or isn't selected.
If the lowest value item in the list has a higher value than your Random Tithe Budget, or if there are no items to select from, then the budget is carried over to the next tax period.
LanguageData.RandomTitheAccruedDesc: The amount of leftover Random Tithe Budget that has accrued. This will be added to your Random Tithe Budget to determine the total budget for Random Tithes at tax time.
LanguageData.DisburseAccruedRandomTitheDesc: If checked, then the Accrued Budget will be disbursed as raw silver come tax time. It will not count towards the Random Tithe Budget.
